question: You and three colleagues have been tasked with quickly finding a trustworthy moving company for your employer’s urgent relocation. You must book one out of three shortlisted companies in the next 20 minutes to avoid extra costs. Each company claims to be able to complete the move on time and has good reviews. Your goal: select the only company that can reliably complete the move by the deadline, given all real constraints.
